alerts.area_desc: Municipality of Skagway
alerts.nws_headline: WIND ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM 7 AM TO 1 PM AKDT THURSDAY
alerts.summary:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 10 to 15 mph with gusts up to 30 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Municipality of Skagway.

* WHEN...From 7 AM to 1 PM AKDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
alerts.title: Wind Advisory issued September 30 at 11:43PM AKDT until October 1 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK

alerts.area_desc: Mobile Coastal; Baldwin Coastal; Escambia Coastal; Santa Rosa Coastal; Okaloosa Coastal
alerts.nws_headline: HIGH RIP CURRENT RISK REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM 7 AM CDT THIS MORNING THROUGH SUNDAY EVENING
alerts.summary:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents expected.

* WHERE...In Alabama, Mobile Coastal and Baldwin Coastal
Counties. In Florida, Escambia Coastal, Santa Rosa Coastal and
Okaloosa Coastal Counties.

* WHEN...From 7 AM CDT this morning through Sunday evening.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
